observation: Original renders essentially unstyled in the browser-default Times New Roman (920 elements) with Arial on form controls (77) and no brand typography; the AI-built page pairs Georgia serif headings (23 elements) with Helvetica Neue sans body text (243 elements)

Original body text is 16px with 'normal' line height in black; the AI-built body is 17px Helvetica Neue with a 27.2px (1.6) line height, with paragraphs in mid-grey rgb(95,108,112) and headings in charcoal

Both pages have a single h1. In the original it reads 'Natural Wellbeing' at 32px, weight 700, black, Times New Roman. In the AI-built page it reads 'All-Natural Supplements For Women Like You' at 51.2px, weight 400, charcoal rgb(43,52,55), Georgia. Both are left-aligned
Original h2s are 80px bold, and the hero h2 'For Women Like You' is much larger than the h1; AI-built h2s are 35.2px at weight 400, smaller than the 51.2px h1

Heading outlines differ. The original has 1 h1, 3 h2, 3 h3 and 1 h4, with h3s used for the value props ('Wellbeing Rewards', 'Meet Our Team', 'Ask An Expert') and an h4 'WHAT'S YOUR EMAIL?'. The AI-built page has 1 h1, 5 h2 (one per section), 23 h3 (product and card titles) and 3 h4 footer column titles

Original uses the browser-default link blue rgb(0,0,238) on about 390 elements against black text, with no brand palette. The AI-built page uses a teal palette: teal rgb(26,138,147) buttons and bars, dark teal rgb(18,106,114) headings and links, and charcoal text

Original backgrounds are only transparent/white plus the default button grey rgb(239,239,239); AI-built backgrounds alternate between white, warm cream rgb(250,248,244), pale aqua rgb(230,243,244), deep teal rgb(18,106,114) and near-black rgb(31,42,45) section bands
Original applies no gradients and no box-shadows; the AI-built hero has a pale teal-to-cream diagonal gradient and the hero image carries one soft shadow
Neither page has backdrop blur or animations. The original has 1 transition and 2 transforms; the AI-built page has 0 of both

Original has 0 border-radius on all 998 measured elements; the AI-built page is mostly square (227 elements at 0) but rounds pill buttons (8 at pill radius) and cards and images (22 in the 8–15px bucket)
Original uses plain block flow with no flex or grid; the AI-built page uses 29 flex and 6 grid containers for multi-column layouts
Original page is about 22,740px tall at 1442px width, mostly from single-column stacking and oversized icons; the AI-built page is 4,731px tall at 1440px

Original content hugs the left edge with the ~8px default margin and no max-width wrapper, leaving most of the viewport empty; AI-built content sits in a centered 1080px column (x=180–1260) with about 70px of vertical section padding

Original has 41 inline SVGs that render unconstrained at viewport scale (user silhouette, Pinterest, Facebook, Instagram, cart), each filling about 1000px of height; the AI-built page has 0 SVG elements and uses text links for Search, Account and Cart
Original's 'Skip to content' link is the first element, a plain blue underlined link at the top-left

Original navigation is a deeply nested bulleted list (19 ul, 95 li) with default markers: a Shop item with category sub-lists and about 25 product links, plus Our Story and similar links. AI-built navigation is a single centered header row of five text links (Shop, Collections, Our Approach, Support, Contact) with the logo on the left and Search/Account/Cart on the right
Original navigation is not wrapped in a nav element and has empty grey dropdown-toggle buttons plus a 'Close menu' button; the AI-built page wraps its links in a nav element

Original renders off-canvas menu, search drawer and cart drawer inline as static content, including a 'Search our store' input and a '"Close (esc)"' button; the AI-built page has no drawers or overlay UI

Original buttons (20) use the browser default: grey rgb(239,239,239) fill, thin border, square corners, 1px 6px padding. The AI-built page uses teal pill buttons: primary 'Shop All' is solid rgb(26,138,147) with white bold text, 999px radius and 12px 26px padding, and secondary buttons are outlined teal pills

Original's free-shipping/'All-Natural Supplements' promo copy is plain stacked text with no banner background; the AI-built page shows the free US shipping over $50 message as centered white text on a thin teal announcement bar above the header

Original hero is a text-only rotating slider: an h2, the tagline 'Mindfully Participate in Your Everyday Wellness' and a 'Shop All' link, with slider images in the DOM at 0×0 so no imagery shows. The AI-built hero is a static two-column split: an eyebrow, serif H1, paragraph and two pill buttons on the left, and a rounded supplements photo on the right
Original ships separate desktop (2000×400) and mobile (600×400) slider image sets, with each slide duplicated as carousel clones
In both pages the product listing shows only name and price, with no product images. Original product images exist in the DOM at 0×0; the AI-built favorites cards contain no img elements

Original lists products as stacked plain text, with a linked name and a blue linked price and no cards or grid. The AI-built 'Customer favorites' section is a 4-column grid of 12 article cards, each with a bold name, a bold teal price, a 1px light-grey border, slightly rounded corners and no shadow
Both pages show variable pricing with a 'from' prefix (e.g. Hair Essentials 'from $29.95'). The AI-built page sets 'from' in a smaller, lighter small element

Original has 5 images missing alt and most others with empty alt; the AI-built page has 0 missing alts, descriptive alt text on photos (e.g. 'Woman exercising with a kettlebell') and empty alt on decorative icons

Both pages use life-stage collection icons (Life Boosters, Glow, Essentials, Transitions). The original shows them at 70×70; in the AI-built page they are 44×44 colored icons (orange, green, teal, pink) beside serif collection titles, with empty alt

Both pages use two logo PNGs at 140×46 and 110×36 with alt 'Natural Wellbeing'. The original renders both side by side mid-page (y≈10830); the AI-built page puts the 140×46 logo in the header and the 110×36 one on a white rounded chip in the footer

Original value-prop block stacks three h3 + sentence + link CTAs in one column (Wellbeing Rewards → 'Get Rewarded', Meet Our Team → 'Say Hello', Ask An Expert → 'Have a Question?'); the AI-built support section is a pale aqua band with three white borderless cards side by side, each with a serif title, paragraph and teal pill button at uneven heights

Both pages use warm, second-person wellness copy aimed at women ('For Women Like You', 'Mindfully'). The original has 636 words, 3 exclamation marks and 2 emoji; the AI-built page has 504 words with no exclamation marks or emoji. Neither uses em dashes
Original CTAs are short link phrases rather than styled buttons; the AI-built page uses pill buttons for main CTAs and underlined teal or bold teal 'Shop … →' text links for secondary ones

Original footer uses collapsible accordion sections rendered open, with each label (Shop / Learn More / Contact Us / SIGN UP AND SAVE) repeated as a button holding a large chevron SVG. The AI-built footer is a near-black four-column layout: a brand column, then ABOUT, HELP and CONTACT, with uppercase white H4s

Original footer links are plain default bullet lists in link blue (5 shop categories, 9+ Learn More links, phone/email/hours); AI-built footer links are underlined light grey rgb(201,211,213) on near-black
Original lists contact details as linked phone +1-800-536-9353, email info@naturalwellbeing.com and Mon–Fri/Sat–Sun/Holiday hours

Both pages have an email newsletter signup. The original's is in the footer under an h4 'WHAT'S YOUR EMAIL?' and 'SIGN UP AND SAVE', with default inputs. The AI-built page uses a deep-teal centered band with an eyebrow, serif H2, a pill email input with a visually hidden label and a white pill Subscribe button
AI-built newsletter band has extra empty space below the form: an empty 26px paragraph and about 135px of teal past the button

Both pages include social links. The original shows a bulleted list with oversized grey SVG icons and small blue text labels (Pinterest, Facebook, Instagram); the AI-built page shows text-only social links in the footer brand column

Both pages end with the FDA disclaimer and the copyright '© 2021 Natural Wellbeing Distribution, Inc.'. The original shows them as centered plain text in a narrow block; the AI-built page shows them as small grey text below a thin divider

Both pages show nine payment-method logos (Amex, Apple Pay, Diners, Discover, JCB, Mastercard, PayPal, Venmo, Visa) in the footer. The original stacks them vertically as a bulleted list of about 38px icons; the AI-built page puts them in a horizontal row of 47×28 white rounded chips, where the Apple Pay icon renders as a mostly empty outline

Original semantic landmarks are only header, main and footer, in a div-heavy DOM (385 divs); the AI-built page adds nav, 5 sections and 17 articles for product and collection cards. Neither uses aside, figure or blockquote
Neither page includes JSON-LD structured data. Both declare lang 'en'

Original head is Shopify-style, with shopify-digital-wallet/checkout meta, Open Graph and Twitter tags and the title 'Holistic Health Supplements – Natural Wellbeing'. The AI-built head has only charset, viewport and description meta, with the title 'Natural Wellbeing | All-Natural Supplements For Women Like You'

Original is script- and style-heavy: 96 scripts, 27 style tags, 8 stylesheets, 96 inline style attributes, 11 noscript blocks and 4 iframes. The AI-built page has 1 script, 1 inline style block, 0 external stylesheets and 2 inline style attributes
Original uses 1190 class tokens (316 unique, about 17% Tailwind-like) with theme-specific names; the AI-built page uses 97 class tokens (33 unique, about 2% Tailwind-like) with semantic names
Original has 81 ARIA attributes, 10 picture/source responsive images, a 1×1 tracking pixel and a FontAwesome element; the AI-built page has 3 ARIA attributes and no picture elements or tracking pixel

All-caps text is limited in the original to 'SIGN UP AND SAVE' and 'WHAT'S YOUR EMAIL?'; the AI-built page uses small uppercase, letter-spaced dark-teal eyebrow labels above every section heading and uppercase footer H4s

AI-built page has a cream 'Product collections' section of photo cards: four in a row (Life Boosters, Life Glow, Life Essentials, Life Transitions) and Wellness Bundles alone on a second row. Each card has a lifestyle photo, an icon, a serif title, a bulleted product list and a 'Shop … →' link
AI-built page shows lifestyle photography of women and a child, plus a capsules-and-herbs still life (NWB-Collection-On-Sale.png) reused as both the hero image and the Wellness Bundles card image

AI-built collection cards are equal height (588px) despite lists of 4–7 items, leaving empty space under shorter lists. The 'Hair Essentials + Fo-Ti Combo' item and the Wellness Bundles link arrow wrap to a second line

AI-built 'Our Approach' section has three text columns with serif teal H3s, grey paragraphs and underlined teal links. The middle H3 repeats the H2 'Inspired by nature, refined by science', and the section closes with a centered serif teal tagline: 'A vibrant mind and healthy body make life's journey best.' The original's equivalent is the h2 'Life is best traveled with a vibrant mind and healthy body.'
